findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_research_entities" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search research entities by name or approximate name. Use this tool whenever a user refers to an entity by name and a research entity UUID is needed. Results ar…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_research_entities, read_research_author, search_research_posts, read_research_post · Public sink: read_research_post · Destructive: search_research_entities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_research_entities, read_research_author, search_research_posts, read_research_post · Public sink: read_research_post · Destructive: search_research_entities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
